smith-college-international-aid-2027.about:
Smith College in Massachusetts, part of the Five College Consortium with Amherst and UMass, meets the full documented financial need of admitted students who apply for aid by the published deadlines, including international students. Admission for international aid applicants is need-aware.

Apply Early Decision I, Early Decision II or Regular Decision via the Common App or QuestBridge, and submit the CSS Profile and required documents by the aid deadline for your round (ED I: 15 Nov).
highlights: Strong STEM incl. engineering for women
smith-college-international-aid-2027.eligibility: Women of any nationality applying as first-years and requesting aid at admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App (RD typically 15 Jan)
Request aid in your application
Submit the CSS Profile and documents by the aid deadline
Receive aid offer with admission
smith-college-international-aid-2027.costs: Grants, work and possible loans covering full documented need.

snu-graduate-scholarship-excellent-forei.about:
Seoul National University's Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS) supports non-Korean applicants who studied in or graduated from eligible countries and are admitted to SNU graduate programmes. It provides full tuition exemption for up to four semesters and living expenses of at least KRW 500,000 per month (varies by major).

There is no separate form: tick 'Application for Scholarship' in the online SNU graduate admission application, and colleges select recipients from the admission documents. The list of eligible countries and participating colleges changes every semester and is published in the Office of Global Affairs guide.
highlights: Full tuition for up to 4 semesters
Applied for within your admission form
snu-graduate-scholarship-excellent-forei.eligibility: Non-Korean applicants enrolled in or graduated from universities in the semester's eligible countries, admitted to a participating SNU college (check the current list for Georgia and Qatar).
how_to_apply: Check the semester's GSFS country and college list
Apply online for SNU graduate admission and tick 'Application for Scholarship'
Submit scholarship evidence documents to the SNU Office of Global Affairs
Colleges select recipients from admitted students
snu-graduate-scholarship-excellent-forei.costs: Full tuition (max 4 semesters) + living expenses from KRW 500,000/month.

snu-president-fellowship-developing-coun.about:
The SNU President Fellowship (SPF) brings faculty members of major universities in developing countries to Seoul National University for a PhD. About eight recipients are chosen each semester, with priority for candidates from Asia, Africa and South America.

It covers full tuition for up to six semesters, living expenses of KRW 1,500,000–2,000,000 per month for three to four years, a round-trip economy airfare and evening Korean classes. Apply by ticking the scholarship box in the SNU graduate admission application and submitting evidence documents to the Office of Global Affairs.
highlights: Aimed at future professors from developing countries
snu-president-fellowship-developing-coun.eligibility: Faculty members of major universities in developing countries without a PhD, newly admitted to an SNU PhD programme (Georgia qualifies as a developing country on most lists; check with SNU).
how_to_apply: Apply for an SNU PhD programme in the Fall 2027 round
Tick 'Application for Scholarship' and select SPF
Submit proof of your faculty appointment to SNU Office of Global Affairs
Selection announced with admission
snu-president-fellowship-developing-coun.costs: Full tuition (6 semesters), KRW 1.5–2M monthly living allowance, round-trip airfare, Korean language classes.

southampton-75th-anniversary-undergradua.about:
The 75th Anniversary Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship celebrates 75 years since Southampton received its Royal Charter. It gives new international undergraduates a tuition fee reduction of £3,000 per year for up to four years (up to £12,000) on any full-time, on-campus bachelor's programme except Medicine.

It is restricted to permanent residents (3+ years) of Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, UAE, USA or Vietnam who pay overseas fees themselves. Students from other countries (including Georgia and Qatar) should check Southampton's scholarship finder for other awards. If you qualify for several Southampton scholarships you receive the highest one.
highlights: Up to £12,000 off tuition over 4 years
southampton-75th-anniversary-undergradua.eligibility: New international (overseas-fee) undergraduates who are permanent residents of Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, UAE, USA or Vietnam, self-funded, holding an offer for a full-time on-campus degree (not Medicine). Citizens/residents of Georgia and Qatar are not on the eligible list.
how_to_apply: Apply for your degree through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; international applicants can often apply until 30 June 2027).
Receive a conditional or unconditional offer.
The scholarship is applied automatically and confirmed by email.
southampton-75th-anniversary-undergradua.costs: £3,000 tuition fee reduction per year for up to 4 years (max £12,000). Does not cover living costs.

sse-riga-bachelor-admissions-scholarship.about:
SSE Riga, a branch of the Stockholm School of Economics in Latvia, runs a highly ranked three-year BSc in Economics and Business. Non-EU/EEA students pay €8,350 a year (fixed for three years) for 2027/28 entry.

Up to 20 Admissions Scholarships offer partial or full tuition fee waivers for one to three years. They are competitive and require no separate application: SSE Riga considers test and interview results, academic excellence, extracurricular activities and cohort diversity. In 2026, 51 bachelor students received €235,810 in scholarships. Open to all nationalities.
sse-riga-bachelor-admissions-scholarship.eligibility: All applicants to the SSE Riga BSc in Economics and Business; awarded competitively on entrance test, interview, grades, activities and diversity.
how_to_apply: Apply to the SSE Riga bachelor's programme.
Take the entrance test and interview.
You are automatically considered for an Admissions Scholarship.
sse-riga-bachelor-admissions-scholarship.costs: Partial or full tuition waiver for 1–3 years (non-EU tuition €8,350/year).

st-andrews-st-leonards-masters-scholarsh.about:
The St Leonard's Masters Scholarship Scheme is the University of St Andrews' main funding route for postgraduate master's students. For overseas fee-status students, awards include full tuition fees plus an £18,000 stipend, 75% tuition reductions with an employability allowance (leadership category), and 25% or 50% tuition reductions (excellence category).

You must meet at least one of the criteria: academic excellence, wider achievement or financial need. There are no nationality restrictions. Apply for your master's (most start September 2027) and submit the scholarship application between 17 August 2026 and 3 February 2027; decisions come in late March.
st-andrews-st-leonards-masters-scholarsh.eligibility: Overseas fee-status applicants to a full-time master's at St Andrews (incl. taught MPhil/MFA first year); no country restrictions, so Georgian and Qatari students can apply.
how_to_apply: Apply for your master's programme at St Andrews
Complete the St Leonard's scholarship application (opens 17 Aug 2026)
Describe your excellence, leadership or financial need
Submit by 3 February 2027; notification week of 22 March 2027
st-andrews-st-leonards-masters-scholarsh.costs: From 25%/50% tuition reduction up to full tuition + £18,000 stipend.

stanford-financial-aid-international-202.about:
Stanford University offers need-based financial aid to a limited number of international (non-US) undergraduates each year. If you request aid in your application and are admitted, Stanford promises to meet your full demonstrated need with institutional scholarship funds, so the family contribution is set by what your family can actually pay.

For international citizens the admission review is need-aware: your aid request is a factor in the decision, so competition is extremely high. Stanford does not award merit scholarships (except a few athletic ones), so need-based aid is the only route to funding.

You must request aid when you apply. Students who do not request aid at admission cannot apply for it later in their four years. Apply Restrictive Early Action by 1 Nov 2026 or Regular Decision by 5 Jan 2027 via the Common App.
highlights: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students
Grants, not loans, from Stanford's own scholarship funds
Apply REA (1 Nov) or RD (5 Jan 2027)
stanford-financial-aid-international-202.eligibility: Citizens of any country applying as first-year undergraduates. International citizens (not US citizens, permanent residents or eligible non-citizens) are reviewed need-aware. Aid must be requested in the admission application. English proficiency expected.
how_to_apply: Submit the Common App to Stanford by 5 Jan 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (REA)
Indicate on the application that you are applying for financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile and financial documents listed on Stanford's financial aid website
If admitted, receive an aid offer that meets your full calculated need
stanford-financial-aid-international-202.costs: Aid covers the gap between Stanford's full cost of attendance (tuition, housing, food, fees, books, personal costs) and the family contribution. Application fee US$90 (waivers possible).

stipendium-hungaricum-bachelor-2027.about:
Stipendium Hungaricum (SH) is the Hungarian government's scholarship for citizens of around 90 partner countries. It funds full bachelor's degrees (as well as master's and PhD) at dozens of Hungarian universities, with hundreds of programmes taught in English or Hungarian.

Applicants register on the online portal, choose up to two programmes and must also be nominated by their country's sending partner (a ministry, council or the Hungarian embassy). Georgia is an SH partner country; check the annex list for your country's quota and allowed study levels. Universities then run their own entrance exams or interviews.
highlights: Housing in a dorm or monthly contribution, plus health insurance
stipendium-hungaricum-bachelor-2027.eligibility: Citizens of Stipendium Hungaricum sending-partner countries (Georgia included; see the annual list) who have or will obtain a secondary-school leaving certificate by enrolment. Hungarian citizens are not eligible. Each partner country sets quotas, levels and fields.
how_to_apply: Check that your country is a sending partner and which levels it supports.
Choose up to two eligible programmes on the SH study finder.
Register on the SH application portal and upload documents (diploma/transcripts, language certificate, motivation letter, medical certificate, etc.).
Submit to your sending partner by its own deadline as well.
Sit the university's entrance exam/interview; results usually come in spring/summer.
stipendium-hungaricum-bachelor-2027.costs: Tuition-free study, monthly stipend (HUF 43,700 at bachelor level in recent calls), dormitory place or HUF 40,000/month housing contribution, and medical insurance.

stipendium-hungaricum-graduate-2027.about:
Stipendium Hungaricum is the Hungarian government's flagship scholarship, managed by Tempus Public Foundation and based on bilateral agreements with around 90 partner countries. It funds full master's and doctoral degrees (as well as bachelor's) at Hungarian universities such as ELTE, Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Corvinus, Debrecen, Szeged and Pécs, with hundreds of English-taught programmes.

The award includes tuition-free education, a monthly stipend, an accommodation contribution (or a dormitory place) and medical insurance. PhD holders receive a considerably higher stipend than master's students. Applicants are first nominated by their home country's Sending Partner (usually the ministry of education) and then admitted by the Hungarian university.

The call for 2027/28 is expected in November 2026, with an online deadline around 15 January 2027 and studies starting in September 2027.
highlights: Tuition-free study plus stipend, housing support and insurance
Hundreds of English-taught master's and PhD programmes
Georgia is among the partner countries
stipendium-hungaricum-graduate-2027.eligibility: Citizens of Stipendium Hungaricum partner countries (Georgia is a partner; check the current list for your country, including Qatar) who are nominated by their Sending Partner and meet the university's admission requirements. Hungarian citizens and dual nationals are excluded.
how_to_apply: Check your country's quota and rules with your Sending Partner (in Georgia: the Ministry of Education)
Choose up to two programmes on the Stipendium Hungaricum programme finder
Submit the online application with transcripts, language certificate, motivation letter and medical certificate before the January deadline
Apply to your Sending Partner as well if it runs its own procedure
Take the university's entrance exam/interview in spring; results in early summer
stipendium-hungaricum-graduate-2027.costs: Tuition waived; monthly stipend (higher for PhD), monthly accommodation contribution or dorm place, medical insurance. No application fee.

stirling-international-undergraduate-sch.about:
The University of Stirling's International Undergraduate Scholarship takes £2,500 off each year's tuition (£10,000 over a four-year Scottish degree) for international students, including EU students paying international fees.

It is available to all countries, including Georgia and Qatar. You need an offer for an eligible undergraduate course starting January 2027, September 2027 or January 2028 and must study full time. It cannot be combined with other Stirling scholarships, and visa students still pay the tuition deposit.
stirling-international-undergraduate-sch.eligibility: Full-time international-fee students (incl. EU) with an offer for an eligible Stirling undergraduate course starting Jan 2027, Sep 2027 or Jan 2028.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Receive a conditional or unconditional offer.
Your annual fee is reduced automatically by £2,500.

strathclyde-physics-international-underg.about:
The University of Strathclyde in Glasgow offers numerous scholarships of £8,000 per year to new international students joining an undergraduate physics degree (year one or two) in 2027/28. The award continues annually for the whole degree, subject to academic progression.

Every eligible new international fee-paying student who registers on a full-time physics degree receives it; there is no nationality restriction, so Georgian and Qatari students qualify.
highlights: Automatic for all international physics entrants
strathclyde-physics-international-underg.eligibility: New international fee-paying students registering for year 1 or 2 of a full-time undergraduate degree in Physics at Strathclyde in 2027/28.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Accept your offer and register on the physics degree.
The scholarship is applied automatically; keep making academic progress to renew it.
strathclyde-physics-international-underg.costs: £8,000 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

surrey-international-excellence-award-pg.about:
The University of Surrey's International Excellence Award is a £5,000 tuition fee waiver for self-funded international fee-paying students starting a master's in September (or February), regardless of nationality or domicile. Awards are decided by a scholarship panel on academic results.

All scholarships must be allocated before your CAS (visa confirmation) is issued, so apply as soon as you hold an offer.
surrey-international-excellence-award-pg.eligibility: Self-funded international fee-paying students (any nationality) starting a master's at Surrey with strong academic results.
how_to_apply: Apply for a Surrey master's
Submit the International Excellence Award application after your offer and before your CAS is issued
Panel decision by email
surrey-international-excellence-award-pg.costs: £5,000 tuition fee reduction for the first year. Living costs not covered.

surrey-international-excellence-award-un.about:
The University of Surrey (Guildford) awards the International Excellence Award, a £5,000 tuition fee waiver, to selected self-funded international students starting a bachelor's degree. It is open regardless of nationality or domicile, so students from Georgia and Qatar can apply.

It is application-based: a panel assesses previous results, predicted grades and your personal statement. Surrey must be your firm UCAS choice, and awards are allocated before CAS issue, so applying early matters.
surrey-international-excellence-award-un.eligibility: Self-funded international fee-paying students starting a Surrey bachelor's in 2027 with Surrey as firm UCAS choice, with a valid student ID/UCAS ID and offer.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Make Surrey your firm choice.
Complete the online scholarship application with your student/UCAS ID before your CAS is issued (final close 24 Aug 2027).

sutd-undergraduate-scholarships-internat.about:
The Singapore University of Technology and Design, founded with MIT, teaches design-centred engineering, computing, architecture and design and AI. International applicants can be considered for scholarships including the SUTD Rainmaker (International), SUTD Trailblazers (International), SUTD Design and Engineering, ASEAN Undergraduate (for ASEAN nationals), Chong Tow Chong, Rock and Wilmar scholarships, plus sustainability scholarships that cover full tuition and add Sustainability Travel and Research Grants.

There is no separate form: indicate your interest in scholarships in the admission application, and SUTD evaluates admission and scholarship together. Each scholarship's page lists its coverage and any bond.
highlights: Full-tuition sustainability scholarships with research grants
sutd-undergraduate-scholarships-internat.eligibility: International applicants to SUTD's undergraduate programmes with academic excellence and leadership; ASEAN scholarships only for ASEAN nationals.
how_to_apply: Apply to SUTD in the AY2027 undergraduate admission window
Indicate scholarship interest in your application
Attend interview/assessment if shortlisted
sutd-undergraduate-scholarships-internat.costs: Varies: up to full tuition (after Singapore Tuition Grant) plus grants, depending on the scholarship.

swansea-international-excellence-scholar.about:
Swansea University offers a number of International Excellence Scholarships to overseas students who have demonstrated academic excellence or show the potential to do so. Awards are tuition fee discounts worth up to £5,000 in the first year, with a further £2,000 in year 2 for £5,000 awardees who achieve a 70% average.

They are open to all nationalities (including Georgia and Qatar) and require an application. The round for January and March 2027 entry closes on 27 November 2026; the September 2027 round opens later in the cycle.
highlights: Separate rounds for Jan/Mar and Sept entry
swansea-international-excellence-scholar.eligibility: Overseas-fee undergraduate applicants of any nationality with strong academic records.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027). (or apply directly for January/March starts).
Complete the online International Excellence Scholarship application in your intake's round.
January/March 2027 entry: submit by 12:00 GMT, 27 November 2026; Sept 2027: watch for the round opening.
swansea-international-excellence-scholar.costs: Up to £5,000 off first-year tuition; £2,000 in year 2 for top awardees with a 70% average.

swansea-thrive-bursary-undergraduate-202.about:
Swansea University's Thrive Bursary gives new self-funding international undergraduates a £4,000 tuition fee reduction in the first year, followed by a £2,000 progression bursary in each later year.

You must be domiciled in one of: Bahrain, Bangladesh, Botswana, Egypt, Ghana, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Kuwait, Lebanon, Malaysia, Morocco, Nigeria, Oman, Pakistan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Tanzania, Thailand, Türkiye, UAE, Uganda, Uzbekistan, Vietnam or Zimbabwe. Georgia is not on the list (Swansea's International Excellence Scholarships are open to all). Awarded automatically.
swansea-thrive-bursary-undergraduate-202.eligibility: New self-funding international undergraduates domiciled in one of 28 listed countries (Qatar included; Georgia not listed).
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Accept your offer and enrol as a self-funded student.
The bursary is applied automatically to your tuition fees.
swansea-thrive-bursary-undergraduate-202.costs: £4,000 off year-1 tuition; £2,000 off each subsequent year.

swarthmore-financial-aid-international-2.about:
Swarthmore College, one of the top liberal arts colleges in the US, meets 100% of institutionally determined need for admitted international students. Aid can cover full tuition, fees, housing, food, academic supplies and some personal expenses, and packages contain no loans. The average award for the Class of 2030 was over US$93,000.

Admission is need-aware for international citizens, so requesting aid affects your chances. Admitted international students receive a CSS Profile fee waiver.

Apply Early Decision or Regular Decision via the Common App, request aid in the application, and submit financial documents through the applicant portal within seven days of your decision.
highlights: Average international award over US$93,000 a year
CSS Profile fee waiver for international students
swarthmore-financial-aid-international-2.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years. If you might need aid at any point in your four years, you must say so on the admission application. English test, Swarthmore video response or InitialView/Vericant interview required.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App (ED I, ED II or RD, typically 4 Jan)
Request financial aid in the application
Submit an English score, Swarthmore Video Response or video interview
Upload financial documents in the portal within 7 days of your admission decision
swarthmore-financial-aid-international-2.costs: Up to full tuition, fees, housing, food, an US$800 book allowance and some personal expenses.

swinburne-george-swinburne-international.about:
Swinburne University of Technology in Melbourne is known for engineering, IT, design, aviation and business. The George Swinburne International Excellence Scholarship gives international students 30% off tuition for the standard course duration when they start an undergraduate or postgraduate course at the Hawthorn campus for the first time in 2027.

You are considered automatically when you apply for an eligible intake, and your letter of offer states the result. It cannot be combined with other Swinburne fee reductions; the Bachelor of Aviation and Piloting is excluded. Female engineering and construction students can alternatively get the 30% Women in Engineering Leadership Scholarship.
highlights: 30% off tuition for the whole course
swinburne-george-swinburne-international.eligibility: International students (not Australian/NZ citizens or PRs) starting an eligible course at Swinburne Hawthorn in 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible Swinburne course at Hawthorn for 2027
Meet entry requirements
Check your letter of offer for the scholarship
swinburne-george-swinburne-international.costs: 30% of tuition fees only (not OSHC or other fees).

taltech-olympiad-medallist-scholarship-2.about:
Tallinn University of Technology's Office of Academic Affairs pays a monthly scholarship to students admitted to TalTech bachelor's programmes who won medals at international subject olympiads in the three years before enrolment. Eligible olympiads: IMO, IPhO, EuPhO, IOI, IOAA, IChO, IESO, IGO, IBO and TalTech's Nordic–Baltic Physics Olympiad.

The award is €800/month for gold, €600 for silver and €400 for bronze, paid from September of the year of admission for the nominal study period, provided the student keeps a GPA of at least 4.0 (on Estonia's 0–5 scale). Students apply with a signed application and the olympiad certificate to their faculty dean's office.
highlights: €400–800 per month for the whole bachelor's
English-taught engineering and IT degrees in the EU
taltech-olympiad-medallist-scholarship-2.eligibility: Students of any nationality admitted to a TalTech bachelor's programme who won a medal at a listed international olympiad within the three years before matriculation; must maintain GPA ≥ 4.0.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to a TalTech English-taught bachelor's programme (international deadlines in early 2027).
After admission, submit a digitally signed free-form application with your bank account to your faculty dean's office.
Attach the certificate confirming your olympiad medal.
Submit by 15 September 2027; keep GPA ≥ 4.0 to continue receiving it.

tobb-etu-international-undergraduate-sch.about:
TOBB ETÜ is a private, non-profit university in Ankara founded by the Union of Chambers and Commodity Exchanges of Türkiye, known for engineering, economics and its cooperative (co-op) education system. Annual undergraduate tuition for international students is $16,500 ($23,100 for Medicine).

It offers purely merit-based tuition discounts of 25%, 50% or 75%; the 25% tier goes to selected highly qualified candidates and the 50%/75% tiers are rare and reserved for outstanding, world-class credentials. Students who start without a scholarship can later earn an Academic Excellence Scholarship with a GPA of 3.50+. Discounts cover tuition only.
highlights: Co-op education with paid work terms
tobb-etu-international-undergraduate-sch.eligibility: International undergraduate applicants with excellent academic credentials (any nationality); later Academic Excellence awards need a 3.50/4.00 GPA.
how_to_apply: Apply through TOBB ETÜ's international undergraduate admissions.
Submit transcripts and exam scores (e.g. SAT, IB, A-levels).
Scholarship tier is decided at admission.
tobb-etu-international-undergraduate-sch.costs: Tuition discount of 25% (pay $12,375), 50% ($8,250) or 75% ($4,125) per year; no housing or stipend.

trinity-college-hartford-international-a.about:
Trinity College is a liberal arts college in Hartford, Connecticut, with strong engineering, economics, public policy and urban studies programmes. It promises: if you are admitted, it will meet your full demonstrated need.

Indicate on your application that you intend to apply for aid, complete the CSS Profile (code 3899, opens early October) and, if parents are separated, the Noncustodial Profile or waiver. Aid deadlines: ED 1 15 Nov, ED 2 and RD 15 Jan; awards come mid-December, mid-February or early April.
highlights: Liberal arts with engineering in a capital city
trinity-college-hartford-international-a.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-year students who request aid in their admission application (aid cannot be requested later).
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App and indicate you will apply for aid
Complete the CSS Profile (code 3899) by 15 Jan 2027
Submit the Noncustodial Profile or waiver if applicable
Receive aid award in early April (RD)
trinity-college-hartford-international-a.costs: Grants, work and loans covering full demonstrated need.

turkiye-burslari-arts-graduate-2027.about:
The Türkiye Scholarships Arts Programme funds international students in performing arts, music and fine arts at three partner universities: Ankara Music and Fine Arts University, Ankara Hacı Bayram Veli University and Istanbul Technical University (home of the renowned MIAM music centre). Graduate options include master's degrees in instrument education, music technologies, music theory, musicology, voice and composition, and a PhD in music sciences.

Winners get the full Türkiye Scholarships package: tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, flights and a one-year Turkish course. Selection weighs your portfolio or performance recordings alongside academics, and shortlisted candidates may be asked for an audition or interview.

Apply in TBBS in the standard 10 January–20 February window and choose the Arts Scholarship Program.
highlights: Rare fully funded route for musicians and artists
Study at ITU or Ankara's specialist arts universities
Same full package as the main Türkiye Scholarships
turkiye-burslari-arts-graduate-2027.eligibility: International applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) with a relevant bachelor's (for master's) or master's (for PhD); master's under 30, PhD under 35; minimum 75% academic achievement.
how_to_apply: Review the list of arts departments on the official programmes page
Prepare a portfolio or performance recordings
Apply through TBBS between 10 January and 20 February, selecting the Arts Scholarship Program
Attend audition/interview if invited
turkiye-burslari-arts-graduate-2027.costs: Fully funded: tuition, monthly stipend (TRY 9,500 master's / TRY 13,000 PhD), accommodation, health insurance, flights, Turkish course.

turkiye-burslari-graduate-2027.about:
Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları) is the Turkish government's fully funded programme for international students, run by the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB). The Graduate Scholarship Programme places winners in master's and PhD programmes in social sciences, humanities, natural sciences and engineering at leading Turkish universities; YTB handles university placement as part of the award.

The scholarship covers full tuition, a monthly stipend (TRY 9,500 for master's, TRY 13,000 for PhD at the time of checking), university dormitory accommodation, health insurance, a one-off return flight and a one-year Turkish language course before the degree. Most programmes are taught in Turkish, so the language year is part of the package.

Applications are made online in the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS) between 10 January and 20 February every year. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed (in person or online) in spring and results come out in summer for an autumn start.
highlights: Tuition, stipend, dorm, insurance and flights all covered
Open to citizens of every country, including Georgia and Qatar
turkiye-burslari-graduate-2027.eligibility: Citizens of any country (not Turkish citizens or those who lost Turkish citizenship). Master's applicants must be under 30 and PhD applicants under 35 on the application date. Minimum academic achievement for graduate candidates: 75% (or equivalent). Graduates or final-year students who will graduate before August may apply. Georgian and Qatari citizens are eligible.
how_to_apply: Search eligible universities and programmes on turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
Create an account in the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS) and fill in the form between 10 January and 20 February
Upload transcript, diploma, passport/ID, photo, statement of purpose, research proposal (PhD) and language scores if available
Choose up to the allowed number of universities and programmes
Attend the interview if shortlisted; results are announced in summer
turkiye-burslari-graduate-2027.costs: Fully funded: tuition, monthly stipend (master's TRY 9,500; PhD TRY 13,000; Merit track pays double), accommodation, health insurance, one-off flight ticket at the start and end, and a 1-year Turkish course. No application fee.

turkiye-burslari-merit-graduate-2027.about:
The Merit Scholarship Program is a special track within Türkiye Scholarships for international students with outstanding academic records. Winners receive the standard Türkiye Scholarships package (tuition, accommodation, health insurance, flights, Turkish course) but with a monthly stipend twice the regular amount.

Eligibility is judged on a high general weighted average plus high scores in international language proficiency and academic qualification exams set by the Presidency (for example IELTS 7.0 for graduate levels, with GRE/GMAT-type results counted). It is aimed at students who would be competitive for top scholarships anywhere.

You apply through the same TBBS system in the 10 January–20 February window and indicate your merit eligibility with test scores; selection includes an interview.
highlights: Monthly stipend twice the standard Türkiye Scholarships rate
Full tuition, dorm, insurance and flights
Rewards strong IELTS/TOEFL and GRE/GMAT scores
turkiye-burslari-merit-graduate-2027.eligibility: International students of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) with a very high GPA and the language/academic test scores listed on the official criteria page (e.g. IELTS 7.0). Master's under 30, PhD under 35.
how_to_apply: Check the Merit criteria for your level on turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
Take the required language and academic tests before February
Apply in TBBS between 10 January and 20 February with all scores uploaded
Attend the interview if shortlisted
turkiye-burslari-merit-graduate-2027.costs: Fully funded with a double monthly stipend (regular rates: master's TRY 9,500, PhD TRY 13,000), plus tuition, accommodation, health insurance, flights and Turkish course.

turkiye-burslari-research-scholarship-q4.about:
The Türkiye Scholarships Research Scholarship supports international researchers, academics and doctoral candidates who want to spend a research period at a Turkish university or research institution, for example for PhD fieldwork, archive work or collaboration with a Turkish supervisor.

Unlike the main degree scholarships, it runs in four application periods a year (January–March, April–June, July–September and October–December). You need a host institution in Türkiye willing to receive you and a clear research plan. The upper age limit is 50.

The grant contributes to living costs during the stay; check the current call on the official site for monthly amounts and what is covered.
highlights: Ideal for PhD fieldwork or archive research in Türkiye
Open to all nationalities up to age 50
turkiye-burslari-research-scholarship-q4.eligibility: Researchers, academics and doctoral students of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) under 50, with an invitation or agreement from a host institution in Türkiye.
how_to_apply: Agree a research plan with a host university or institute in Türkiye
Apply in TBBS during an open Research Scholarship period
Upload CV, research proposal, host acceptance and degree documents
Await evaluation; awards are made after each period
turkiye-burslari-research-scholarship-q4.costs: Monthly research stipend during the stay; extent of travel/insurance support defined in each call.

turkiye-burslari-success-scholarship-202.about:
Besides its main degree scholarships, Türkiye Scholarships runs a Success Scholarship for international students who are already studying in Türkiye without a government scholarship and who have strong academic results. It is a way to obtain Türkiye Scholarships support part-way through a bachelor's, master's or PhD.

Applications are taken each October–November through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS). Successful students receive Türkiye Scholarships benefits (such as the monthly stipend and health insurance) for the remaining period of their programme, as set out in the annual call.
highlights: For students already enrolled in Türkiye
Adds Türkiye Scholarships stipend and benefits
turkiye-burslari-success-scholarship-202.eligibility: International students (any nationality incl. Georgia and Qatar) currently enrolled at a Turkish university at their own expense with high academic achievement; not already holding a Turkish government scholarship.
how_to_apply: Log in to TBBS (tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr)
Select the Success Scholarship call during October–November
Upload transcript, student certificate and passport
Await evaluation and results
turkiye-burslari-success-scholarship-202.costs: Türkiye Scholarships benefits for the remaining study period (stipend: master's TRY 9,500, PhD TRY 13,000 at current rates; insurance). Details in the annual call.

turkiye-burslari-undergraduate-2027.about:
Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları), run by the government agency YTB, is a competitive, merit-based programme for citizens of all countries. It funds associate, bachelor's, master's and PhD study and also handles university placement, so you are admitted to a Turkish university as part of the award.

Bachelor's applicants must be under 21 and meet minimum grade averages (90% for Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy). Selection is by online application and interview. Students from Georgia, Qatar and every other country can apply; Turkish citizens and those who have lost Turkish citizenship cannot.
highlights: Monthly stipend, dorm, insurance and flights
Open to citizens of every country
turkiye-burslari-undergraduate-2027.eligibility: Citizens of all countries (not Turkish citizens or former Turkish citizens), under 21 for bachelor's, graduating from secondary school by August of the application year, meeting the minimum grade average (90% for Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy). Not for students already enrolled at the same level in Türkiye.
how_to_apply: Watch the official site for the 2027 call (expected 10 January).
Create an account on the online application system (free).
Choose up to 12 university programmes and upload transcripts, ID, photo, test scores and a statement.
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed (in person or online).
Results are announced in summer; scholars start with a one-year Turkish course.
turkiye-burslari-undergraduate-2027.costs: Full tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, one-time round-trip flight and a one-year Turkish language course.

turku-uas-early-bird-discount-bachelor-2.about:
Turku UAS charges €12,000 per year for its English-taught bachelor's programmes. Students admitted through the joint application, separate application or rolling admission receive a €1,000 Early Bird discount on first-year tuition if they accept the offer within 14 days and pay via Flywire within 30 days of the acceptance email.

It is available to all fee-paying nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar. It is not offered for transfer applications or renewed study rights.
highlights: Applies to joint, separate and rolling admissions
turku-uas-early-bird-discount-bachelor-2.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA fee-paying students admitted to a Turku UAS English-taught degree starting January 2026 or later (excludes transfer/renewed study right).
how_to_apply: Apply in Finland's joint application for English-taught bachelor's programmes on Studyinfo.fi (usually early-to-mid January; check the 2027 dates).
Accept your offer within 14 days of the acceptance email.
Pay the first-year fee through Flywire within 30 days.

ualberta-presidents-international-distin.about:
The University of Alberta in Edmonton offers several large awards for international first-year students on a study permit. The President's International Distinction Scholarship goes to 25 students a year and is worth up to CA$120,000 paid over four years. With the same application you are also considered for the Chan Pang Kuen Memorial International Distinction Scholarship (up to CA$120,000) and the International Leader Scholarship (up to CA$15,000).

Separately, all admitted international students are automatically assessed for the International Admission Scholarship (up to CA$10,000) and Regional Excellence Scholarship (up to CA$5,000) based on their admission average. First apply to a degree programme, then complete the single scholarship application by 10 January.
highlights: Up to CA$120,000 over four years
One application covers several international awards
Automatic admission awards up to CA$10,000 as well
ualberta-presidents-international-distin.eligibility: First-year international students who will study on a Canadian student visa. Strong academic record plus leadership.
how_to_apply: Apply to a University of Alberta undergraduate programme
Complete the single scholarship application (leadership and achievement questions) by 10 Jan 2027
Offers are made from early winter
ualberta-presidents-international-distin.costs: Up to CA$30,000 a year toward international tuition (around CA$30,000-45,000) and costs.

ubc-four-year-doctoral-fellowship-2027.about:
From September 2026 onward, the University of British Columbia's Four Year Doctoral Fellowship (4YF) gives recipients a CAD 24,000 annual stipend plus tuition for up to four years of doctoral study. It is UBC's main tool for attracting outstanding domestic and international PhD students with stable base funding, and graduate programs often top it up with research or teaching assistantships.

There is no direct application: each UBC graduate program nominates its strongest incoming and continuing doctoral students and sets its own internal deadline. Apply to your PhD program by its admission deadline (often December–January) to be considered.
ubc-four-year-doctoral-fellowship-2027.eligibility: Outstanding doctoral students (international and Canadian) in UBC PhD programs; nominated by their program.
how_to_apply: Find a UBC PhD program and supervisor
Apply for admission by the program deadline
The program nominates eligible students for 4YF
Funding is confirmed with or after the admission offer
ubc-four-year-doctoral-fellowship-2027.costs: CAD 24,000 stipend per year plus tuition, up to 4 years.

ubc-international-major-entrance-scholar.about:
The University of British Columbia (Vancouver and Okanagan campuses) gives two merit-based entrance awards to outstanding international students. The International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES) is worth CA$10,000-25,000 a year for 2027/28 and is renewable for up to three further years; the Outstanding International Student (OIS) Award is a one-time award of CA$10,000-25,000.

Both are based on academic achievement, intellectual promise and extracurricular or community involvement, not financial need. You are considered automatically when you apply to UBC by the admission deadline; decisions come between mid-February and the end of April, before the 1 May acceptance date. Students nominated for the separate International Scholars Program cannot receive these awards.
highlights: CA$10,000-25,000 per year, renewable up to 4 years (IMES)
Decisions before the 1 May acceptance deadline
ubc-international-major-entrance-scholar.eligibility: International students who will study on a Canadian study permit, new to UBC, entering directly from secondary school (OIS also allows post-secondary transfers). Exceptional grades and strong extracurriculars.
how_to_apply: Apply to UBC by 15 Jan 2027 with your personal profile
Submit grades and documents as requested
No scholarship form needed: successful recipients are notified between mid-February and April
ubc-international-major-entrance-scholar.costs: Partial: CA$10,000-25,000 a year against international tuition of roughly CA$45,000-60,000.

uchicago-financial-aid-international-202.about:
The University of Chicago offers need-based financial aid to international first-years who apply for it during the admission process, and automatically considers all first-year applicants (including internationals) for merit scholarships.

International applicants do not file the CSS Profile or FAFSA; instead they submit UChicago's Student Financial Aid Worksheet, an asset verification form and income documents (tax forms or a home-country equivalent translated into English and converted to US dollars, or employer statements/bank records where no tax filing exists). Apply in Early Action, Early Decision I/II or Regular Decision rounds via Common App or Coalition.
highlights: Need-based aid plus automatic merit consideration
Own free aid worksheet instead of the CSS Profile
Several rounds: EA, ED I, ED II, RD
uchicago-financial-aid-international-202.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years. Aid only if requested during admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App or Coalition (EA/ED I 1 Nov; ED II/RD early January 2027)
Indicate you are applying for aid
Submit the Student Financial Aid Worksheet, asset verification form and income documents
Merit scholarships are considered automatically
uchicago-financial-aid-international-202.costs: Need-based grants toward the full cost of attendance; merit scholarships vary.

uclan-excellence-scholarship-internation.about:
The Excellence Scholarship is the University of Lancashire's (formerly UCLan) merit award for international students who meet high, country-specific entry criteria. For 2027/28 entry it is worth £3,500 in the first year, and later years are funded if you achieve an average mark above 60%.

It is applied automatically as a fee reduction for undergraduate and postgraduate taught students from a long list of countries, including Georgia, and can be combined with other awards up to £5,500 a year.
uclan-excellence-scholarship-internation.eligibility: International students from listed countries (Georgia included) who meet the enhanced country-specific academic entry criteria for their programme.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027). (or apply directly).
Meet the enhanced entry criteria for your country (ask the International Team).
The reduction is applied automatically; keep a 60%+ average to renew.
uclan-excellence-scholarship-internation.costs: £3,500 tuition fee reduction in year 1; subsequent years subject to an average above 60%. Combinable up to £5,500/year.

uea-international-undergraduate-merit-sc.about:
The University of East Anglia offers its International Undergraduate Merit Scholarship as an annual tuition fee discount for the whole degree: £10,000 per year for lab-based Faculty of Science courses, £7,000 per year in Economics, Law, Psychology and Norwich Business School, and £5,000 per year in all other schools (and for year-2 pathway entrants).

It is open to international fee payers of any nationality, including Georgia and Qatar, and is confirmed automatically shortly after an offer is made. Some programmes (e.g. Medicine) are excluded; see the page.
uea-international-undergraduate-merit-sc.eligibility: International fee-paying students starting an eligible UEA undergraduate degree in September 2027 (exclusions listed on the page).
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Receive an offer from UEA.
The scholarship is confirmed automatically shortly after your offer.
uea-international-undergraduate-merit-sc.costs: £10,000, £7,000 or £5,000 tuition fee discount per year depending on school.

umanitoba-international-excellence-entra.about:
The University of Manitoba in Winnipeg offers the International Excellence Entrance Scholarship: one award of CA$25,000 (requires a 90%+ admission average in five senior courses) and two of CA$10,000 (meet programme admission requirements), for international students entering first year full-time with demonstrated leadership and sustained community involvement.

You must complete a University of Manitoba admission application (fee paid) and the scholarship application with one recommendation letter from a current teacher or principal by 1 Dec 2026. Shortlisted applicants are ranked using both applications.
umanitoba-international-excellence-entra.eligibility: International students entering first year full-time (80%+ course load) in University 1 or a direct-entry faculty.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to the University of Manitoba and pay the fee
Complete the International Excellence Entrance Scholarship application
Arrange one recommendation letter from a teacher or principal
Submit everything by 1 Dec 2026
umanitoba-international-excellence-entra.costs: One CA$25,000 and two CA$10,000 awards against tuition of roughly CA$20,000-25,000 a year.

unil-masters-scholarship-2027.about:
The University of Lausanne awards around ten Master's Scholarships each year to students who graduated from a foreign university with excellent results. The grant pays CHF 1,600 per month for the minimum statutory length of the master's and exempts holders from course registration fees (only CHF 80 semester fees remain). It does not fully cover Swiss living costs.

The application is a single PDF (CV with photo, two-page covering letter, diplomas and transcripts, language certificate, school diploma, passport, proof of the CHF 200 fee) plus two recommendation letters emailed by referees to mastergrants@unil.ch. Everything must arrive by 1 November 2026; results come in early April 2027.
highlights: Any UNIL master's except a few excluded programmes
unil-masters-scholarship-2027.eligibility: Holders of a foreign bachelor's recognised as equivalent to a Swiss bachelor (all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar), not currently enrolled at UNIL, with very high academic results.
how_to_apply: Check eligible master's programmes on the UNIL page
Pay the CHF 200 administrative fee
Upload one PDF with CV, letter, diplomas, transcripts, language certificate and passport
Have two referees email letters to mastergrants@unil.ch by 1 November 2026
unil-masters-scholarship-2027.costs: CHF 1,600 per month; tuition waived (CHF 80 semester fee payable). CHF 200 application fee.

university-college-roosevelt-need-based-.about:
University College Roosevelt is a small, residential, English-taught liberal arts and sciences college of Utrecht University. All UCR scholarships are need-based: you qualify only if your parents' combined net income is below €40,000 a year.

Regional Scholarships go to nationals who completed their last two school years in the region (one each for Europe, Australia & Asia, Central & South America, North America, and the Middle East & Africa, plus three for the Netherlands). Non-European regional awards are €10,000 paid over three years; there are also Academic Excellence Scholarships for top-10% students in need, a scholarship for a student affected by war, and Andrew Brooks Entrance Scholarships in Science. Students from Georgia and Qatar can apply under the relevant region.
highlights: Regional awards incl. Middle East & Africa
university-college-roosevelt-need-based-.eligibility: Incoming UCR students whose parents' combined net annual income is below €40,000; regional awards require nationality and the last two school years in that region.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to UCR's Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor's.
Submit the UCR scholarship application with proof of parental income.
Indicate the regional, war-affected or science scholarship you qualify for.
university-college-roosevelt-need-based-.costs: €5,000 (European fee) or €10,000 (non-European fee) paid in equal parts over years 1–3; non-EU tuition about €12,651 in 2027-28.

university-of-limerick-international-mer.about:
UL in Limerick, Ireland, offers partial merit-based scholarships for international (non-EU) undergraduates in each faculty: €2,000 per year in Science and Engineering and in Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences, and €2,500 per year at the Kemmy Business School. They are tuition fee reductions.

There is no separate application: once you apply for a programme you are automatically reviewed and told at the same time as your offer. Any non-EU nationality qualifies, including Georgia and Qatar. Extra awards exist for Indian students.
university-of-limerick-international-mer.eligibility: Non-EU (international fee-paying) applicants to UL undergraduate programmes, judged on academic merit.
how_to_apply: Apply for your UL undergraduate programme (international direct application).
You are automatically considered for a faculty scholarship.
The scholarship decision is sent with your offer.
university-of-limerick-international-mer.costs: Tuition reduction of €2,000 per year (Science & Engineering; Arts, Humanities & Social Sciences) or €2,500 per year (Kemmy Business School).

university-of-nicosia-academic-merit-sch.about:
The University of Nicosia (UNIC) teaches most bachelor's degrees in English, including business, computing, law, pharmacy, psychology and the arts. First-year students receive an academic merit scholarship as a percentage reduction on tuition, based on the grades of their High School Leaving Certificate (scaled to the issuing country), valid for one year.

After two semesters, ongoing scholarships reward university performance: 50% for a 4.00 GPA, 20% for 3.75–3.99 and 10% for 3.50–3.74. You must study full time (30 ECTS/semester). Athletic scholarships up to 40% also exist. International students from Georgia, Qatar and elsewhere are eligible.
highlights: First-year merit reduction from school grades
Up to 50% later for top GPA
English-taught degrees in an EU country
university-of-nicosia-academic-merit-sch.eligibility: Full-time undergraduate students who submit their High School Leaving Certificate on application; later awards need a 3.50+ cumulative GPA.
how_to_apply: Apply to a UNIC bachelor's programme with your school-leaving certificate.
Register full time (30 ECTS per semester).
Your first-year merit percentage is applied to tuition; keep a 3.5+ GPA for later awards.
university-of-nicosia-academic-merit-sch.costs: First-year percentage tuition reduction (grade-based); 10%, 20% or 50% per semester afterwards depending on GPA.

unsw-international-student-award-2027.about:
UNSW Sydney, a top-20 QS university, offers the International Student Award: a 20% contribution toward tuition each term for the full duration of an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programme, for students from a published list of eligible countries starting in 2026 or 2027. It can be combined with other UNSW scholarships.

To apply, upload a personal statement (max 500 words) on why you want to study your programme at UNSW in the applicant portal; you need an offer of admission, and new applicants hear within two days of their offer. UNSW's flagship International Scientia Coursework Scholarship (full tuition or A$20,000 a year) is a separate, highly competitive option.
highlights: 20% off tuition for the whole degree
unsw-international-student-award-2027.eligibility: International students from eligible countries (see UNSW's list) commencing full-time on-campus study. Excludes UNSW Canberra, Online, AGSM, Foundation programmes.
how_to_apply: Check that your country is on the eligible-countries list
Apply to a UNSW undergraduate programme
Upload a 500-word personal statement in the applicant portal
Receive confirmation after your offer
unsw-international-student-award-2027.costs: 20% of tuition each term (UNSW international tuition roughly A$50,000-60,000/year).

uoft-lester-b-pearson-international-scho.about:
The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is the University of Toronto's most prestigious award for international students. It covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years, and about 37 Pearson Scholars are named each year. It recognises exceptional academic achievement, creativity and leadership in school and community.

You must be nominated by your secondary school (one student per school per year). For 2027 entry, school nominations closed on 9 Oct 2026 and the OUAC admission application on 16 Oct 2026; nominated students receive a private link and must submit the scholarship application and documents by 6 Nov 2026. If you are in an earlier school year, ask your counsellor to have the school register for the next cycle (forms go to schools from early July).
highlights: Full tuition, books, fees and residence for 4 years
Nomination by your secondary school required
uoft-lester-b-pearson-international-scho.eligibility: Non-Canadian students who need a study permit, in their final year of secondary school in 2026/27 (or graduated no earlier than June 2026), starting at U of T in September 2027. Students already in post-secondary study are not eligible.
how_to_apply: Your school nominates you (closed 9 Oct 2026 for this cycle)
Apply to at least one U of T undergraduate programme via OUAC
Complete the private-link scholarship application and upload documents by 6 Nov 2026
Finalists are notified by U of T
uoft-lester-b-pearson-international-scho.costs: Tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years (worth over CA$300,000).

uow-university-excellence-scholarship-in.about:
The University of Wollongong, south of Sydney, offers the University Excellence Scholarship: a 30% tuition fee reduction for the minimum duration of an eligible undergraduate course at an Australian campus. It goes automatically, with no limit on numbers, to international students with outstanding results in Australian Year 12 or an approved international senior secondary qualification or pathway.

Recipients must study full-time and keep a cumulative WAM of 50. It cannot be combined with other UOW discounts, and some degrees (Social Work, Education, Psychological Science) are excluded.
highlights: 30% off tuition for the whole degree
uow-university-excellence-scholarship-in.eligibility: International students with outstanding senior secondary results enrolling full-time in an eligible UOW undergraduate course in 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply to an eligible UOW undergraduate course
Submit final results so eligibility can be assessed
Scholarship is included in your offer

uq-international-excellence-scholarship-.about:
The University of Queensland in Brisbane, a Group of Eight university in the global top 50, offers the UQ International Excellence Scholarship: a 25% reduction in tuition fees every semester for the duration of the programme. It is available for undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programmes commencing in 2027.

You do not apply: UQ assesses you automatically when you apply for a programme, ranking offer holders by a competitive score. You must meet entry rank and English requirements and satisfy all offer conditions, and cannot hold another UQ fee reduction or a full external scholarship.
highlights: 25% off tuition for the whole degree
uq-international-excellence-scholarship-.eligibility: International students applying for full-time study at UQ commencing in 2027 in an eligible programme, with a competitive score among offer holders.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible UQ undergraduate programme starting in 2027
Meet entry rank and English requirements
Scholarship offer (if any) arrives with your letter of offer
uq-international-excellence-scholarship-.costs: 25% of tuition each semester (UQ international tuition roughly A$45,000-55,000/year).

uwa-global-excellence-scholarship-2027.about:
The University of Western Australia in Perth, a Group of Eight research university, offers the Global Excellence Scholarship to international students starting in 2027. Undergraduates receive 10% off tuition with an ATAR of 85 or equivalent, or 20% off with 90 or higher, for the normal full-time duration of an eligible degree (including combined bachelor's/master's and Assured Pathways, except medicine and dentistry).

You do not apply separately: admissions assesses eligibility from your final transcripts when you apply to your course. It cannot be combined with other UWA tuition reductions and requires meeting continuation criteria.
highlights: 10-20% off tuition for the whole degree
Group of Eight university in Perth
uwa-global-excellence-scholarship-2027.eligibility: International students commencing an eligible UWA undergraduate course in 2027 with ATAR 85+ or international equivalent.
how_to_apply: Apply to an eligible UWA undergraduate course
Submit final transcripts so admissions can assess the scholarship
Receive the scholarship on your offer
uwa-global-excellence-scholarship-2027.costs: 10% or 20% tuition reduction (international tuition roughly A$40,000-48,000/year).

uwe-bristol-international-student-schola.about:
UWE Bristol awards International Student Scholarships of up to £4,000 (first year only) to international fee payers joining undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses.

The university considers course choice, personal statement, academic references and performance, interviews, skills and experience and domicile, at its discretion. There is no application: successful candidates are contacted once an offer is made. Any nationality can be considered.
highlights: Bristol, one of the UK's top student cities
uwe-bristol-international-student-schola.eligibility: International fee payers applying to UWE Bristol undergraduate courses; awarded at the university's discretion.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Write a strong personal statement and secure good references.
UWE contacts you about the scholarship when it makes your offer.
